description: One-call URL status check: final HTTP status, redirect chain, TLS validity and days-to-expiry, response time, and whether the body changed since a previous call (pass previous_hash). Charges 0.0001 XNO in Nano via x402.

previous_hash.description: Optional hash of the body from a previous call, used to detect content drift.
previous_hash.title: Previous Hash

url.description: Full http(s) URL whose status, redirect chain, TLS validity and content to check.
url.title: Url

name: check_url_status
